upgrades.name: Kitchen
upgrades.description: More nourishing snacks and a one-run meal. At level 2 and 4, carry one extra pack item.

upgrades.name: Training Gym
upgrades.description: Raises Pip’s training cap and awards more points from mini-games.

upgrades.name: Workshop
upgrades.description: Reduces upgrade and fusion Scrap costs, and expands the permanent gear bag.

upgrades.name: Nursery
upgrades.description: Passes down more family traits and grows the family’s legacy stat bonus.

upgrades.name: Library
upgrades.description: Form discoveries add a small stat bonus and unlock clearer evolution clues.
